metadata.description: Marketplace for the RuleLedger skill: standing rules that survive long AI agent sessions.

plugins.description: Keep standing rules from rotting in long AI agent sessions. Extract numbered rules, freeze them with a hash, re-read them before shipping, audit every rule against the diff with file and line evidence, and record the verdict in a ledger. Use when a project has standing rules and the agent will ship code in a long session, after compaction, or across multiple sessions.
plugins.name: ruleledger
